package repository

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"time"
)

type HybridReplanning interface {
	ReceivePlanningStateEvent(context.Context, domain.PlanningStateChangedEvent) (bool, error)
	ClaimHybridEvaluationWork(context.Context, time.Time, time.Duration) (domain.HybridEvaluationWork, bool, error)
	CheckpointHybridSnapshot(context.Context, domain.HybridEvaluationWork, domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot, string) (string, error)
	ReleaseHybridEvaluationWork(context.Context, domain.HybridEvaluationWork, time.Time) error
}
